personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 8 Hand-Drawn (for parchment/wood textures)
personality_one_liner: A dark, textured, pirate-steampunk adventure wrapped in deep wood, antique brass, and aged parchment.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to allow textures to breathe, structured margins to frame content like pages in an old book.

do's: Use subtle glass over dark wood backgrounds to separate header and tab bars.
Use heavy tint (≥75% surface/surfaceSecondary opacity) behind glass to maintain text readability.
dont's: No high-blur glass on parchment cards (it breaks the organic material feel).
Avoid bright/white frost. Glass must be tinted with deep wood (#161311) or brass.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Immersive landing with the main title and CTA to begin the adventure.

states.loading: Centered brass-colored spinner on wood background.
states.error: Parchment card with dark ink error message and brass retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a compass/map (home_hero). A dark vertical gradient scrim fades from top (transparent) to bottom (90% surface opacity). Large display text 'LA CONFRÉRIE DES HÉRITIERS' sits at the top 1/3 (simulating a scroll banner). Narrative text in the middle. Sticky 'COMMENCER L\'AVENTURE' CTA button pinned to the bottom. Button has a brass border (borderStrong) and surfaceTertiary/brandPrimary tint.

screens.name: Monde
screens.purpose: Provide world lore and universe description.
screens.layout: Dark wood background. Single-column scrollable layout containing a large 'Parchment' card (surfaceInverse background). Text inside uses onSurfaceInverse (dark ink) for high contrast and readability. A decorative brass-colored header divider.

screens.name: Classes
screens.layout: 2-column grid of cards using space-between. Each card uses surfaceSecondary with a borderStrong (brass) outline. Displays character thumbnail, class name in displayFontFamily. Tapping opens a full-screen image modal or detailed card.

screens.name: Quêtes

states.empty: Password input overlay covering the screen. Once unlocked: empty quest list.

screens.layout: Initial state: Centered password input on wood background with a lock icon, 'ENTRER LE CODE' button. Unlocked state: Scrollable list of quest cards. Each row has a leading wax-seal or skull icon, quest title, and a chevron.

screens.name: Journal

states.empty: An empty parchment graphic with 'Aucune entrée.'

screens.layout: Vertical timeline. Entries are styled as torn parchment blocks (surfaceInverse base, onSurfaceInverse text) layered over the dark wood background. Dates are highlighted in bold serif.

screens.name: Passeport
screens.layout: 2-column grid of passport page thumbnails. Each thumbnail card has a small download icon button (brandPrimary color) in the corner. Heavy shadows to make them look like physical paper stacked on wood.

home_hero.alt: Antique compass on a vintage world map

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette to achieve the Pirate/Steampunk aesthetic. Use surfaceInverse (#E3CBA8) and onSurfaceInverse (#2A1E17) heavily for cards to simulate text written on parchment.
Use borderStrong (#A37D35) for framing buttons and cards to mimic brass trimmings on dark wood.
The Bottom Tab Bar must use a dark wood-like background tint (surface) with brandPrimary (brass/gold) active icons and onSurfaceSecondary for inactive icons. Avoid standard white/grey tab bars.
For the Home screen, ensure the background map image has a strong dark gradient scrim (vertical, transparent to #161311) so the narrative text and the primary CTA button pop out perfectly.
For the 'QUÊTES' screen, implement a full-screen password overlay before showing the list of quests. Use a simple text input and a submit button.
For the 'CLASSES' screen, ensure cards in the 2-col grid fill the width equally (flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between'). Do not leave orphans stretching.
Make sure haptics are wired up for tab changes, button presses, and the quest unlock action.
